rows.context_and_review_note: Revised entire drawing to entire drawing area so unpainted canvas is included. adɣar is an ordinary place/area paraphrase, not a new specialist canvas noun. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:673 uses this accessibility description for the Fit button. PaintCanvas.kt:176–192 fits the bitmap plus any outlying trim/floating selection, with padding; on the screen describes visibility, not entering fullscreen mode.
